title: This free AI tool replaced my /month subscription

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: This tool isn’t just free—it’s built on open protocols that give you full control, unlike proprietary subscriptions. (3 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Free tools often lack security and updates. You’re trusting unknown code, not a company with a proven track record. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Open-source AI tools like this one use secure, auditable code—no hidden backdoors, no subscription lock-in. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: But free tools can’t scale. When your needs grow, you’ll hit limits that a paid service is designed to overcome. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Free is a trap—eventually, you’ll pay in performance, support, and reliability. (4 sec)
